title: 容量分析技术
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/01_Volumetric Techniques.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/01_Volumetric Techniques/src.py

points.K1: 精确量取与四种容量器具
points.K12: 清洗移液管，吸球不进水
points.K21: 清洗并倒置晾干容量瓶

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上摆着移液管、容量瓶、滴定管和注射器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a pipette, a volumetric flask, a burette on a stand and a syringe, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲容量器具的规范使用。

shots.scene: 四种器具图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a volumetric pipette with a rubber bulb, a volumetric flask, a burette with a stopcock, and a small syringe. No people.
shots.narration: 四件器具，量得准还要用得安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一大堆玻璃器具发愁，手里拿着空白实验讲义
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks puzzled at a bench full of glassware, holding a blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 阿杰下周第一次上化学实验课。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一支移液管和一个红色吸球，不知怎么装
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a glass pipette in one hand and a red rubber bulb in the other, looking unsure.
shots.narration: 移液管、滴定管，他都没用过。

shots.scene: 小研笑着走过来，指向四种器具
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over smiling and points at a pipette, a flask, a burette and a syringe.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把四种器具的用法预习一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 量多量少，结果就差很远。

shots.section_title: 精确量取与四种容量器具
shots.scene: 一勺胡椒倒得太多的图标，旁边一个天平倾斜
shots.prompt_en: An icon of too much pepper pouring from a shaker onto a dish, next to a tilted balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 做菜多放点调料，顶多不好吃。
overlay: 精确量取与四种容量器具

shots.section_title: 精确量取与四种容量器具
shots.scene: 烧杯里的溶液旁边出现精确刻度图标
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of clear solution next to a precise measuring scale icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 实验里用量不准，结果就不可靠。

shots.section_title: 精确量取与四种容量器具
shots.scene: 欣欣指着桌上的四种器具
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a pipette, a burette, a volumetric flask and a syringe laid out on a bench.
shots.narration: 今天学这四种器具怎么用。

shots.scene: 干净透明的玻璃器具闪着光，旁边一支挂满污渍的被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Clean clear glassware sparkling on the left; a stained cloudy pipette on the right crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃仪器一定要保持清洁。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准清晰的刻度线
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over clear graduation marks on a glass tube. No people.
shots.narration: 干净了，刻度才看得清楚。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标与液面在同一水平线上
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon level with the liquid surface in a glass tube, a dashed horizontal line connecting them. No people.
shots.narration: 读数时，视线和液面保持水平。

shots.scene: 放大的弯曲液面，最低点被箭头指出
shots.prompt_en: A magnified curved liquid surface inside a glass tube, an arrow pointing at its lowest point. No people.
shots.narration: 液面是弯的，读它最低的那一点。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套在水槽边刷洗玻璃器具
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat and gloves, washes glassware at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 清洗分四步，每步都要冲干净。

shots.scene: 四个图标依次排列：洗涤剂、龙头、蒸馏水瓶、晾干架
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a detergent bottle, a water tap, a wash bottle of distilled water, and a drying rack. No people.
shots.narration: 洗涤剂洗，自来水冲，蒸馏水冲。

shots.scene: 溶剂洗瓶冲洗后放上晾干架
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle rinses a glass tube, which is then placed on a drying rack. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时再用溶剂冲洗，然后晾干。

shots.scene: 一支移液管和刻度特写
shots.prompt_en: A glass volumetric pipette with its graduation marks shown in close-up. No people.
shots.narration: 移液管用来量取少量液体。

shots.scene: 吸球装在移液管上方，向上的箭头表示吸力
shots.prompt_en: A rubber bulb attached to the top of a pipette, with an upward arrow showing suction. No people.
shots.narration: 靠吸球造成的负压，把液体吸上来。

shots.scene: 三阀吸球特写，三个阀门处各有一个空白圆点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red rubber three-valve pipette bulb with three small blank dots marking the valves. No people.
shots.narration: 这种吸球上有三个阀。

shots.scene: 手指捏住顶部阀并挤扁球体
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pinches the top valve and squeezes the rubber bulb flat. No people.
shots.narration: 捏住排气阀挤扁球体，形成负压。

shots.scene: 手指分别捏下方阀和侧面阀，液体上升和下降的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pinches the lower valve with an upward arrow, then the side valve with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 捏吸液阀就吸，捏放液阀就放。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地举起红色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a red warning triangle with a serious face.
shots.narration: 记住：绝不能用嘴吸取液体！

shots.scene: 嘴吸管图标打叉，吸球图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mouth on a tube crossed out with a red X, next to a rubber bulb icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 一定要用吸球或移液器。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套，把移液管插入烧杯，上面装着吸球
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, dips a pipette fitted with a rubber bulb into a beaker.
shots.narration: 先排气形成负压，再捏吸液阀。

shots.scene: 液面在移液管里上升，再随着放液下降
shots.prompt_en: Liquid rises up inside the pipette, then flows back down into the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 液体上来了；捏放液阀，液体放下。

shots.scene: 手指再次捏住顶部阀，吸球鼓起
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pinches the top valve again and the rubber bulb puffs back to its round shape. No people.
shots.narration: 用完再捏排气阀，把负压放掉。

shots.scene: 液面吸到零刻度以上，内壁被湿润
shots.prompt_en: Liquid is drawn up above the top mark of a pipette, coating the inner wall. No people.
shots.narration: 正式量取前，先吸过零刻度润洗。

shots.scene: 移液管里的液体全部放进旁边的小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: All the liquid in the pipette drains into a small separate beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 润洗用的液体全部放掉。

shots.scene: 液面再吸过零刻度，然后缓缓下降停在零刻度线
shots.prompt_en: Liquid is drawn above the top mark again, then slowly lowered until it rests exactly on the mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再吸过零刻度，慢慢放到零刻度。

shots.scene: 另一种方法：液面慢慢上升正好停在零刻度
shots.prompt_en: Another view: liquid rises slowly and stops right at the top mark of the pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以慢慢吸，正好停在零刻度。

shots.scene: 液体冲进吸球的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid rushing up into the rubber bulb, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别让液体进入吸球。

shots.scene: 手指轻轻捏阀，液面缓慢上升
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger gently pinches the valve and the liquid rises slowly and steadily. No people.
shots.narration: 吸液要慢，眼睛盯住液面。

shots.section_title: 清洗移液管，吸球不进水
shots.scene: 移液管在水槽龙头下冲洗，吸球放在一旁
shots.prompt_en: A pipette is rinsed under a lab sink tap, with its rubber bulb set aside on a dry towel. No people.
shots.narration: 移液管照常清洗。
overlay: 清洗移液管，吸球不进水

shots.section_title: 清洗移液管，吸球不进水
shots.scene: 水滴流进吸球的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water drops entering a rubber bulb, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吸球里不能进任何液体。

shots.scene: 一只带塞的梨形容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: A pear-shaped volumetric flask with a glass stopper and a single line on its neck. No people.
shots.narration: 容量瓶用来配制和稀释溶液。

shots.scene: 桌上摆着容量瓶、漏斗、玻璃棒、烧杯、洗瓶和滴管
shots.prompt_en: A volumetric flask, a funnel, a glass rod, a beaker, a wash bottle and a dropper laid out on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 备好漏斗、玻璃棒、溶剂和滴管。

shots.scene: 小研打开瓶塞，从称量纸小心倒入粉末
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, removes the stopper and carefully tips weighed powder from a paper into the flask.
shots.narration: 从固体配制，小心加入称好的固体。

shots.scene: 烧杯中的溶液沿玻璃棒经漏斗流入瓶中
shots.prompt_en: Solution from a beaker flows down a glass rod through a funnel into the volumetric flask. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以用浓溶液，靠漏斗和玻璃棒引流。

shots.scene: 洗瓶冲洗烧杯、玻璃棒和漏斗，三个图标各标三次
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle rinses a beaker, a glass rod and a funnel; three icons each show three small drops. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯、玻璃棒、漏斗，各冲洗三次。

shots.scene: 冲洗液全部流进容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: All the rinse liquid flows into the volumetric flask. No people.
shots.narration: 洗下来的液体全部并入容量瓶。

shots.scene: 小研向瓶中加水到约一半
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours water into the volumetric flask until it is about half full.
shots.narration: 加溶剂到大约半瓶。

shots.scene: 手握瓶颈轻轻旋摇
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds the flask by the neck and swirls it gently. No people.
shots.narration: 摇一摇或颠倒几次，帮助溶解。

shots.scene: 继续加水，液面停在刻度线下方
shots.prompt_en: More water is added; the liquid level stops below the mark on the flask neck. No people.
shots.narration: 再加溶剂，但先别加到刻度线。

shots.scene: 瓶颈内壁的液滴慢慢流下，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Drops on the inner wall of the flask neck slowly run down, with an hourglass icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 静置一会儿，让瓶颈上的液体流下。

shots.scene: 瓶底有白色未溶固体，箭头指向它
shots.prompt_en: White undissolved solid sits at the bottom of the flask, with an arrow pointing to it. No people.
shots.narration: 看看瓶底，还有没有没溶的固体。

shots.scene: 小研盖紧瓶塞，颠倒容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the stopper firmly and turns the flask upside down.
shots.narration: 没溶完就继续摇动、颠倒。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁，小研用滴管向瓶颈逐滴加水
shots.prompt_en: Next to an hourglass icon, the female graduate student adds water drop by drop into the flask neck with a dropper.
shots.narration: 沥流约一分钟后，用滴管逐滴加。

shots.scene: 凹液面最低处正好与刻度线相切
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the flask neck: the lowest point of the curved liquid surface sits exactly on the mark. No people.
shots.narration: 凹液面最低处正好对准刻度线。

shots.scene: 塞紧瓶塞，反复颠倒混匀
shots.prompt_en: The stoppered flask is turned upside down and back several times. No people.
shots.narration: 塞好瓶塞，颠倒几次混匀。

shots.scene: 干净干燥的储液瓶
shots.prompt_en: A clean dry glass storage bottle with a screw cap and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 配好的溶液，转入干净干燥的储液瓶。

shots.scene: 少量溶液倒入储液瓶润洗后倒掉
shots.prompt_en: A small amount of solution is poured into the storage bottle, swirled and poured out. No people.
shots.narration: 可先用少量溶液润洗储液瓶。

shots.scene: 手握容量瓶再颠倒几次
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the stoppered volumetric flask upside down a few more times before pouring. No people.
shots.narration: 转移前，再把容量瓶摇匀。

shots.scene: 小研倒入溶液，拧紧瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the solution into the storage bottle and screws the cap on tightly.
shots.narration: 倒入后，把瓶盖拧紧。

shots.section_title: 清洗并倒置晾干容量瓶
shots.scene: 容量瓶倒置夹在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: A washed volumetric flask clamped upside down on a ring stand to drain. No people.
shots.narration: 容量瓶照常清洗，倒置夹好晾干。
overlay: 清洗并倒置晾干容量瓶

shots.scene: 滴定管装在铁架台上，下方是锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A burette clamped on a ring stand above a conical flask on a white stirrer. No people.
shots.narration: 滴定管能精确地一点点滴加。

shots.scene: 液滴从滴定管尖嘴落入锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A single drop falls from the burette tip into the conical flask. No people.
shots.narration: 比如在滴定中使用。

shots.scene: 小研的手环握滴定管活塞处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wraps her gloved hand around the burette at the stopcock.
shots.narration: 手从后面环握活塞。

shots.scene: 食指推活塞上部，液体流出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the forefinger gently pushes the upper part of the stopcock and liquid flows out. No people.
shots.narration: 食指轻推上部，液体流出。

shots.scene: 中指推活塞下部，液体停住
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the middle finger gently pushes the lower part of the stopcock and the flow stops. No people.
shots.narration: 中指轻推下部，液体停住。

shots.scene: 小研取下滴定管，用小漏斗加入少量滴定液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the burette below eye level and adds a small amount of titrant through a small funnel.
shots.narration: 先加少量滴定液。

shots.scene: 滴定管横持转动，液体润湿内壁
shots.prompt_en: A burette held almost level is rotated so the liquid coats the inside wall. No people.
shots.narration: 倾斜转动，让它润湿整个内壁。

shots.scene: 润洗液从尖嘴全部放掉，再装到零刻度以上
shots.prompt_en: The rinse liquid drains out of the tip, then the burette is filled above the top mark. No people.
shots.narration: 放掉润洗液，再装到零刻度以上。

shots.scene: 尖嘴里的气泡被放大镜圈出
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass highlights an air bubble trapped in the burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 尖嘴里有气泡，读数就会出大错。

shots.scene: 手指快速来回转动活塞，液体一股股流出
shots.prompt_en: Fingers quickly turn the stopcock back and forth, letting small spurts of liquid out into a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 快速来回转动活塞，一点点放液。

shots.scene: 尖嘴里充满液体，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The burette tip is now completely filled with liquid, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 气泡没了，才能开始。

shots.scene: 液面慢慢降到零刻度附近
shots.prompt_en: The liquid level in the burette slowly drops to near the top mark. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢放到零刻度附近就行。

shots.scene: 小研在空白记录本上写下读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a reading in a blank lab notebook beside the burette.
shots.narration: 不必正好是零，但一定先记下初读数。

shots.scene: 小研弯腰，眼睛与滴定管液面平齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends slightly so her eyes are level with the liquid in the burette.
shots.narration: 读滴定管，一样要平视。

shots.scene: 从上方和下方看的两个眼睛图标打叉，平视的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three eye icons beside a burette: looking from above and from below are crossed out with red X marks, looking straight across has a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 从上或从下看，读数都会偏。

shots.scene: 刻度特写，平视读数图示
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of burette graduations with the lowest point of the meniscus marked by a level eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 平视读，读数是3.50毫升。

shots.scene: 刻度特写，下方和上方两个眼睛图标各对着一个读数
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of burette graduations with one eye icon below the meniscus and one eye icon above it, each pointing to a slightly different mark. No people.
shots.narration: 从下面看成3.55，从上面看成3.45。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，平视图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods next to a level eye icon with a green check.
shots.narration: 结论：避免视差，一定平视读数。

shots.scene: 小研用长柄刷刷洗滴定管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scrubs inside a burette with a long burette brush at the sink.
shots.narration: 清洗滴定管用长柄刷。

shots.scene: 水流从滴定管尖嘴冲出
shots.prompt_en: Water runs out through the tip of the burette under the tap. No people.
shots.narration: 洗涤剂和水洗，尖嘴也要冲到。

shots.scene: 一支带弯长针头的小注射器
shots.prompt_en: A small syringe fitted with a long curved needle. No people.
shots.narration: 注射器用来转移极少量的液体。

shots.scene: 弯针头伸进烧杯吸液
shots.prompt_en: The curved needle dips into a beaker and the plunger is pulled back to draw up liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 用弯针头吸取，比需要的多吸一点。

shots.scene: 手指轻弹针筒，气泡上升到顶部
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger taps the syringe barrel and an air bubble rises to the top. No people.
shots.narration: 轻弹针筒，让气泡升到顶部。

shots.scene: 推动活塞到所需刻度，针尖挂一小滴
shots.prompt_en: The plunger is pushed to the needed mark; a tiny drop hangs at the needle tip. No people.
shots.narration: 推出多余的液体，气泡也一起排出。

shots.scene: 活塞往回拉一点，针头里出现一小段空气
shots.prompt_en: The plunger is pulled back slightly, drawing a small cushion of air into the needle. No people.
shots.narration: 再抽一小段空气垫，保护液体。

shots.scene: 注射器移到另一只烧杯，推出液体
shots.prompt_en: The syringe is moved to a second beaker and the liquid is pushed out. No people.
shots.narration: 然后转移到接收容器。

shots.scene: 针头里还有液体的图标，带问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a needle still holding liquid, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 以为推完了？针头里还有液体。

shots.scene: 倒置注射器，抽一下再推，残液排出
shots.prompt_en: The syringe is turned upside down, the plunger pulled back then pushed, expelling the last liquid into the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 倒过来抽一抽再推，把残液排净。

shots.scene: 针头、针筒、活塞三部分分开平放
shots.prompt_en: A needle, a syringe barrel and a plunger laid out separately. No people.
shots.narration: 清洗前，先拆成三部分。

shots.scene: 三部分分别清洗后放上晾干架
shots.prompt_en: The three parts are washed separately, rinsed and placed on a drying rack. No people.
shots.narration: 分别清洗，溶剂冲洗后晾干。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧一本空白实验讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，代替不了实验讲义。

shots.scene: 书本和烧杯图标并列，中间是加号
shots.prompt_en: A book icon and a beaker icon side by side with a plus sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 原理和操作，两样都要掌握。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现眼睛、洗瓶、刻度线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an eye, a wash bottle and a graduation line.
shots.narration: 仪器洗干净，平视读最低处。

shots.scene: 移液管和容量瓶图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A pipette icon and a volumetric flask icon with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 用吸球不用嘴，定容要逐滴。

shots.scene: 滴定管和注射器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A burette icon and a syringe icon with green checks. No people.
